decisions.reason: Using the referenced video as shared How-To media changes content delivery, not the measurement sequence or its instructions.
The source selects shared How-To media for Android and iOS but does not change Android localization coverage or language count.
The How-To video decision does not affect whether social-media links resolve.
The word media refers to How-To video content, not social-media links or their localization.
The source selects shared How-To media for both platforms but does not alter iOS localization coverage or the supported language set.
A shared How-To video is compatible with the existing optimization goals, but the source does not change the Android size target or localized-asset strategy.
The How-To media choice has no entailed effect on Android permission policy or removal of READ_PHONE_STATE.
Selecting a shared How-To video does not change the current Android modernization, deprecated-API, or maintainability requirements.
The shared video decision does not modify required right-to-left layout behavior.
A shared How-To video does not necessarily change the existing iOS size goal or reusable localized-asset strategy.
The source changes How-To media delivery but does not alter iOS framework modernization or maintainability requirements.
The shared How-To video decision has no entailed effect on the requirement to provide an iOS Privacy Manifest.
